entries/blocks/flowers.json::/pages/1/te: A flower with healing properties, Aum is a component in many spells. It can be found in forests.
entries/blocks/flowers.json::/pages/2/te: Cerublossom flowers thrive in lush, green environments. They were one of the first magical plants discovered, being used in potions and light-focused spells. A short while after its discovery, it was also noted that the Cerublossom could be used as part of the $(l:items/purified_vinteum_dust)purification process for Vinteum Dust$().
entries/blocks/flowers.json::/pages/3/te: Desert Novas grow in dry conditions. The Nova has extraordinary magical properties for a desert plant, and is highly sought after. It is one of the two plants used in the $(l:items/purified_vinteum_dust)purification process of Vinteum Dust$().
entries/blocks/flowers.json::/pages/4/te: Lighter than it looks, Tarma Root grows in mountain biomes. It is an ingredient in spells and air essences.
entries/blocks/flowers.json::/pages/5/te: Growing on the surface of water in warm climates, Wakebloom is used in water-based spells frequently, as well as being a component in water affinity essences.
entries/blocks/ores.json::/pages/1/text: Found where the stones shift, Chimerite is used in spells that require a great deal of alternation or illusion.
entries/blocks/ores.json::/pages/2/text: Found in the deepest depths or on the highest peaks, Topaz is commonly used as an entry level magical crystal.
entries/blocks/ores.json::/pages/3/text: Found relatively common in most layers of the world, Vinteum Dust quickly proved itself a viable magical resource.
entries/blocks/ores.json::/pages/4/text: Rarely found in meteorites that crashed upon the world a long time ago, Moonstone is a celestial material with extraordinary magical powers.
entries/blocks/ores.json::/pages/5/text: Sunstone gems were formed over thousands of years inside patches of obsidian touching the nether's lava oceans. Despite this, they are not fire-resistant, and great care must be taken to obtain them.
entries/bosses/nature_guardian.json::/pa: Dryads spawn in forests. They can be lured with saplings and boost nearby plants' growth.
entries/entities/mana_creeper.json::/pag: Mana creepers drop $(l:blocks/ores#vinteum)Vinteum Dust$() when killed.
entries/mechanics/getting_started.json::: The Occulus has five tabs, the first four of which are skill tree tabs.
The search bar can be used to quickly find a spell part. The name bar can be used to name your spell, this is not required though.
Drag the skills down to the shape groups and the spell grammar section.
The shown spell recipe is $(l:shapes/projectile)Projectile$()-$(l:components/dig)Dig$(), which is recommended for beginners.
